title: AI Adoption Beyond the Slop
description: Separate attention from reorganized work; understand hidden use and social permission, then judge adoption through learning, segments and disconfirming cases.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: AI Adoption Beyond the Slop examines useful work hidden behind loud demonstrations online.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Separate attention from reorganized work; understand hidden use and social permission, then judge adoption through learning, segments and disconfirming cases.
readerOutcomes: Separate public visibility from evidence of useful work.

Distinguish assisted output from retained competence.

bookJourney.focus: Distinguish attention, trial, repeated use and reorganized work.
